task-handoff.title: Task handoff
task-handoff.intro: Propose a new person responsible for this task. The recipient must accept; this does not run tools or approve delivery.
task-handoff.recipient_unavailable: Previous recipient is no longer eligible
task-handoff.create_unavailable: A new handoff is currently unavailable
task-handoff.no_recipients: First register a project person linked to a real account. Current project and team eligibility is checked by the server.
task-handoff.accept_impact: Accepting changes the responsible person, moves the task to In progress, and invalidates its verified delivery and downstream results. Original runs, tests and reviews stay available. No execution or delivery acceptance is created.
task-handoff.accept_ack: I understand and agree to the responsibility change and invalidation of downstream results.
task-handoff.accept_default_reason: I accept responsibility for this task.
task-handoff.text_invalid: Enter a note and shorten it if it is too long.
task-handoff.decision_changed: This handoff changed. Read the latest version and choose an available action again.
task-handoff.original_operation: An original operation still needs confirmation
task-handoff.saved.pending: Handoff sent. Waiting for the recipient.
task-handoff.saved.accepted: Responsibility accepted. This is separate from delivery approval.
task-handoff.invalid_read: Handoff information is incomplete or belongs to a different task. Refresh before continuing.
task-handoff.refresh_failed: The operation was confirmed, but the latest task could not be loaded. Refresh the task details.
task-handoff.access_changed: Your current access changed. Refresh the task details.
task-handoff.private_cleared: Protected handoff information has been cleared. Reopen task details after your access is restored.
task-handoff.invalid_draft: The stored draft could not be read. It has been preserved; discard it explicitly to start again.
task-handoff.storage_failed: The draft could not be saved on this device. Keep this page open until it is saved.
